"""Regression for ENG-1886: scope allowlist must come from the catalog.

    A previous implementation derived the allowlist by querying
    ``information_schema.tables`` for the ``config`` schema. That view
    only lists DuckDB views actually bound on the current connection,
    and ``search`` only preloads ``config.text_references`` before
    validating scope. In prod, every other producer-declared scope was
    therefore invisible to the validator and rejected as unknown
    (``Unknown scope value(s) ['apexclass'] for search(): no config
    table in this org has matching source_type.``), even though the
    catalog knew about it. Dev fixtures bound every config view
    eagerly, so the bug was invisible locally.

    This test reproduces the prod state exactly: only
    ``config.text_references`` is bound on the connection, but
    ``apexclass`` is declared in the catalog. ``search(scope=["apexclass"])``
    must succeed. If anyone reintroduces ``information_schema.tables``
    as the allowlist source, this test fails.
    """
